title: Keep Mac release aligned with current repository
notes: Preserve the latest Store edition and shared dot. brand changes alongside the full-feature Homebrew Mac app, faster discovery, native startup animation and transparent Netflix fullscreen subtitle controls. Direct-download DMG signing remains blocked by the Apple account Admin role.

title: Full-feature Mac distribution and faster discovery
notes: Keep the full AppKit/WebKit study app available through Homebrew and GitHub DMG/source artifacts. Add fading previous-subtitle, play/pause and next-subtitle buttons in Netflix fullscreen, stronger outlined captions with no background, and a visible native startup animation. Remove the titlebar separator, reuse installed native builds and install only Mac runtime dependencies. Use bounded public YouTube metadata with parallel language checks and yt-dlp fallback for faster discovery. Developer ID creation is blocked by the current Admin role; the DMG is not notarized until the Account Holder supplies a Developer ID Application certificate.

title: Make subtitle word lookup accessible
notes: In the Store edition, expose individual subtitle word lookups through native accessibility actions while preserving tap-to-lookup and the dot. design. Keep the trailing dot in native app naming. Store review and physical-device acceptance remain pending.

title: Complete the Immersed. Store name
notes: Use Immersed. consistently in the installed app name and Store listing. App Store review and interactive release checks remain pending.

title: Add a separate imported-media Store edition
notes: Prepare an isolated App Store edition for local videos and SRT/VTT subtitles, offline JMdict lookup, and saved words; retain the full community app. Store builds and Apple review remain pending.

title: Part of dot.
notes: Apply shared dot. surfaces, typography, controls and indigo accents while preserving the video stage, subtitle replay, spoken-verb lookup and learning states.
Add accessible suite discovery and companion links in Settings; refresh runtime tokens through the shared brand-kit workflow.
Improve narrow-screen desktop layout, keyboard focus and contrast.

title: Resolve spoken Japanese verb lookups
notes: Recover dictionary-attested katakana verbs and spoken conjugations across tokenizer boundaries, including シメてる and 粋がってんじゃねえ. Preserve original captions, spaces, punctuation and offsets; keep nouns and names distinct. Improve dictionary part-of-speech ranking. Unsupported fictional names still have no invented definition.

title: Subtitle replay and reliable word context
notes: Added current-subtitle replay (R), optional pause after timed subtitles, and context replay from recent lookups. Saved-word progress now uses canonical dictionary forms. Netflix saved context waits for the requested title before seeking. Pause-at-end requires real timed cues and stays off for visible-line-only Netflix subtitles.

title: Match Netflix to immersed’s shared design
notes: Use immersed’s shared glass toolbar, colors, cards, popups and icons in Netflix, while retaining the minimal reader and transparent fullscreen captions. The layout stays within narrow panes and expands lookup without moving the subtitle. All 32 Netflix browser checks, lint and typecheck passed; the underlying v0.20.0 playback, keyboard and dictionary fixes are retained.

title: Minimal Netflix reader, transparent captions and reliable hover resume
notes: Remove the unsigned Mac build’s WebCrypto Keychain dependency using in-memory session keys and renew Netflix playback caches. Native encrypted-key reload and transparent backing checks passed without a Keychain prompt; picture and fullscreen playback were confirmed in the current Mac session. Netflix remains dependent on its embedded-player support, and encrypted web sessions may require sign-in again after restart.

Replace Netflix’s information panel with a compact toolbar and centered captions. Fullscreen captions have a transparent background, and expanding lookup keeps the hovered text stationary. Subtitle tracks are selected in Netflix itself.

Add persistent 1 Unknown, 2 Learning, 3 Known and 4 Ignored word actions. Move hover pause/resume ownership into Netflix’s player, retain manual pauses, and navigate original subtitle blocks through its controller.

Improve dictionary-backed spoken contractions, omitted particles and expressive endings, including しら切んな, 気回さなくて and ふんっ. Context sense selection receives validated grammar and preserves prohibitions. All 106 Mac browser tests, native session checks, language tests, lint, typecheck and Apple Silicon build passed.

title: Keep Netflix fullscreen lookup inside every window size
notes: Let the floating Netflix subtitle and dictionary panel shrink within smaller windows while preserving full video bounds. Native layout checks passed at 800×600, 1320×860 and 1850×1000, including expanded lookup. Original subtitle timing and playback-rate synchronization are retained. Netflix returned S7353-5101 during a live seek check; protected playback remains dependent on Netflix’s embedded-player support.

title: Fix Netflix fullscreen native layout
notes: Use native constraints for video-filling Netflix fullscreen and an expanding interactive subtitle lookup panel. Match caption changes and clears to Netflix’s displayed original subtitles and reflect playback-rate changes. Lint, typecheck, 90 Mac browser tests and native build passed; native fullscreen geometry was checked at multiple window sizes. Netflix returned S7353-5101 during a live seek test, so protected playback remains dependent on Netflix’s embedded-player support.

title: Enable Netflix video fullscreen and synchronize original captions
notes: Netflix fullscreen fills the video area with a floating interactive subtitle and word-lookup panel; its fullscreen control, F and Escape use the same layout. Subtitle changes and clears follow Netflix’s displayed caption events instead of timer-only track estimates, and the speed icon follows Netflix playback rate. Original timed tracks remain available for subtitle navigation. Verified fixtures and native build; live playback check follows installation.

title: Bring vocabulary and subtitle improvements to iPhone
notes: Add estimated vocabulary coverage beside the iPhone app icon, retain shared N2/N1 katakana familiarity and honorific dictionary lookup, refine Japanese spacing and punctuation, navigate subtitle blocks with swipes and embedded controls, and add a text-free native splash and animated startup. The Expo Go preview is updated; native iPhone playback and the new startup have not been checked on a physical phone. No signed TestFlight update is published by this release.

title: Improve vocabulary coverage, lookup and subtitle controls
notes: Show estimated video vocabulary coverage beside the icon; assume katakana known at N2/N1 while respecting explicit choices; resolve honorific nouns; isolate the on-screen caption strip and align corrections to word boundaries; remove the orange uncertainty line; route embedded YouTube seek controls to subtitle blocks; add text-free startup animation and faster readiness checks. Coverage is an estimate and speech/OCR can still be imperfect. Netflix protected playback remains unverified.

title: Add Netflix original-subtitle study
notes: Add an in-app Netflix pane using original subtitle text, shared word lookup and saved words, hover pause/resume, subtitle navigation, speed and side-by-side fullscreen. No speech generation or offline Netflix downloads. Netflix may reject embedded playback; authenticated subscription playback is not yet verified.

title: Refine Japanese subtitle typography
notes: Keep quotes and punctuation with their words, remove artificial token spacing, and preserve hover lookup in normal and fullscreen playback.

title: Natural Japanese typography and general word-boundary repair
notes: Improve Japanese spacing, paragraph wrapping and furigana without artificial gaps between interactive words.
Generalize dictionary-backed repairs across up to four subtitle fragments for compounds, kana words and inflections, preserving all characters and audio bounds across refreshes.

Use sharper source frames and retry missed caption checks. Require repeated OCR agreement; weaker quoted-compound matches additionally need dictionary and phonetic evidence. Preserve original speech text; absent, paraphrased or unreadable source captions can still leave recognition errors.

title: Resume hover-paused playback through YouTube buffering
notes: Track playback intent through YouTube buffering so hover lookup does not mistake a buffer for a manual pause. Close temporary lookup when keyboard focus leaves it, and clear lookup when opening a panel.

title: Dismiss hover lookup reliably and keep split words readable
notes: Subtitle clicks no longer pin hover lookup. Leaving the word and card closes it and resumes only playback paused by lookup; preserve the hovered target during subtitle refreshes and respect manual pauses.
Handle pointer exit into embedded video, explicit playback, and accidental reopening after Close. Clear stale text during subtitle gaps.
Join dictionary-confirmed split words such as 読 / 者 in the Mac reading view, preserving transcript characters and audio bounds. Recognition errors can still remain; no guessed wording is substituted.

title: Show saved subtitle sections immediately on reopening
notes: Restore prepared subtitle cues while source audio is still downloading so returning to a long video does not hide already-completed output.

title: Stabilize native fullscreen idle controls and warm-model progress
notes: Hide native fullscreen chrome with explicit element state as well as fullscreen styling, keeping subtitle lookup available.
Keep measured transcription progress visible when the same MLX speech model is reused instead of reporting another model load for each section.

title: Quiet fullscreen and current-video subtitle priority
notes: Fade fullscreen controls after inactivity while subtitles and dictionary lookup stay interactive. Reveal controls from the bottom edge or keyboard focus, with reduced-motion support.
Default Discover to native Japanese audiences and domestic discussions, with a persistent toggle to include learner content while preserving language and length filters.

Prioritize speech at the current video playhead, checkpoint completed sections and continue remaining work in bounded background sections. Replace the three-video rejection with priority scheduling and resumable background pauses; downloads and model loading can still take time.
Reduce redundant subtitle scans and play-button updates, and suspend hidden study rendering while Discover is open.

title: Keep speech preparation display uncluttered
notes: Use concise speech stages in the progress bar and hide duplicate footer status while preparation is active.

title: Floating glass navigation and vocabulary progress
notes: Use a floating glass icon toolbar and transparent Mac title area, with accessible labels, tooltips, keyboard focus and active navigation states.
Keep the latest 100 dictionary lookups locally, reopen them and save words directly from history. Deduplicate rapid hover lookups and preserve original video context.
Track Saved, Learning and explicitly Known words with persistent progress and include lookup history in exported backups. Automatic iCloud sync still requires signing.

title: More discovery, trackpad study and clearer speech progress
notes: Find additional discovery pages with the same language and length filters, up to 72 candidates per search.
Add native trackpad subtitle navigation, stable fullscreen lookup anchoring and a measured speech progress bar with honest loading states.

Start audiobook look-ahead eight seconds earlier and poll missing subtitles faster. Keep GPU-accelerated Turbo recommended; reject a shorter-chunk experiment that increased total time. WhisperKit and Kotoba need further validation before replacing the engine.

title: Discover Japanese podcasts and conversations on Mac
notes: Add a dedicated Mac Discover page with podcast, interview, culture, everyday-life and ideas topics, plus search in the embedded app.

Share original-Japanese, minimum-length and Shorts settings with discovery. Conversation first favors spoken content and filters obvious music/gameplay; metadata cannot guarantee every result is entirely speech.
Preserve the current player when switching between Discover and Watch. Cache results and show confirmed originals progressively.

title: Bundle the iPhone fallback player
notes: Load the fallback YouTube player from the app bundle instead of the unavailable GitHub Pages URL or temporary Expo tunnel. Preserve Japanese caption and playback bridges.

This removes the gateway page inside an already-open app; Expo Go launch still requires a live development server. YouTube can still deny embedded playback, and captionless videos still need an accessible audio source.

title: Use stable GitHub Pages player fallback
notes: Host the HTTPS YouTube fallback player on GitHub Pages and load it from a fixed address instead of the expiring Expo preview tunnel. Keep the player bridge and Japanese caption relay unchanged.

The Expo Go app itself still needs a running development server, and YouTube may still block playback in any embedded player. Signed iPhone distribution remains blocked on Apple signing credentials and permanent language-service hosting.

title: Keep the iPhone preview retrying
notes: Run the Expo preview under a detached supervisor and keep retrying tunnel failures with bounded backoff instead of stopping after eight failures.

The preview remains tied to this temporary cloud workspace; a workspace shutdown or a newly assigned Expo URL can still interrupt the link. Permanent availability requires hosting outside the preview session.

title: Preserve Japanese captions when playback is blocked
notes: Keep a retrieved Japanese transcript readable when YouTube blocks embedded playback, and distinguish that playback restriction from failed subtitle generation. Wait for a sustained watch-page failure before switching players.
This cannot override videos unavailable in both YouTube players. Fresh captions for videos without a usable Japanese track still require an audio source, unavailable in the Expo Go preview.

title: Ground context lookup in dictionary meanings
notes: The local model now selects an existing dictionary definition and quotes the actual subtitle phrase. Free-form definitions are no longer displayed. A wider caption context supports the ranking, and uncertain results are cached. The model can still choose an incorrect sense.

title: Smoother subtitle navigation and fullscreen study
notes: Previous/next and arrow or J/L keys move between adjacent subtitle blocks. Floating hover lookup preserves layout, resumes only playback it paused, and keeps actions visible. Dictionary lookup uses the selected reading and shows attested expressions immediately.

Fullscreen includes interactive subtitles, lookup and a compact playback-speed menu. Opening a video clears its URL from search, completed transcripts have no status notice, and Save offline keeps the current player in place.

On Mac, Apple Vision can match two small video-frame samples to a speech block and use confirmed on-screen Japanese captions. The reported paper-church homophone error was corrected in native verification. Frame access, OCR and speech recognition can still fail; videos without usable visible captions continue to use Whisper.

title: Keep phrase context for inflected verbs
notes: Recognize dictionary phrases around a selected verb even when its inflected form is longer than the phrase's dictionary form.

title: Video fullscreen and contextual dictionary
notes: Expand only the embedded video with F or the player fullscreen button. Add local sentence-aware dictionary explanations with surrounding captions and dictionary-attested phrases; preserve instant definitions.
Apple Silicon prepares a 2.2 GB Qwen3 MLX model in the background. Context explanations are generated suggestions and can be mistaken; normal lookup remains available during setup or failure.

title: Refine progressive search layout
notes: Keep the language toggle compact and align video thumbnails, titles and metadata in a responsive three-column search layout.

title: Faster search, instant lookup and fullscreen study
notes: YouTube search fetches lightweight listings first and verifies original-language metadata progressively, with an in-place language toggle and redesigned video cards. Subtitle recognition prepares a short playhead-first preview before filling the rest of a minute, persists coverage across interruptions and preloads the next section earlier. Captions supplied by YouTube are fetched before downloading audio. Word definitions are prefetched with sentence analysis and cached by reading; dictionary search updates while typing and resolves additional potential and negative adjective forms. Add a fullscreen button, F key, Control-Command-F and embedded-video fullscreen. Search depends on YouTube access and language metadata; speech remains generated and unverified.

title: Restore kanji subtitle default
notes: Revert the 0.9.5 forced large-v3 default, which produced kana-only text in the reported audiobook section. Restore turbo and its existing kanji transcript on upgrade; preserve listening position, learned words and reading settings. Later explicit model choices remain available. The alternate model is no longer labelled as a guaranteed accuracy upgrade. Subtitle wording is preserved rather than guessing kanji from kana.

title: Cleaner subtitles and Japanese dictionary lookup
notes: Remove Listening filler and regeneration controls from the study view. Temporary subtitle failures recover automatically with bounded retries, and large-v3 becomes the default once while later model choices remain available. Dictionary lookup resolves inflected and continuative forms such as 吸い取り, keeps attested compound verbs together, respects readings and labels reading-only matches. Lookup now shows headwords, parts of speech, dictionary sources and expandable meanings. Speech recognition can still make mistakes; dictionary readings never silently replace subtitle wording.

title: Subtitle loading status and release verification
notes: Keep model loading distinct from recognition progress, so a newly requested section does not report a misleading zero-percent download. Automated checks now install FFmpeg, exercise desktop subtitle logic and run mobile and desktop browser suites against their own services.

title: Cross-checked subtitle timing and Whisper decoding
notes: Mac and iPhone now share the rolling YouTube caption parser. Whisper uses bounded surrounding audio context, word ownership at chunk boundaries and limited confidence-based decode retries. Fixes cached retries, immediate model switching, stale captions and misleading cross-model comparison caused by different segmentation. Earlier cached sections remain available; regenerate a section to use the updated decoder. Model agreement and confidence are not a guarantee of transcription accuracy.

title: Faster audiobooks and reliable listening progress
notes: Long audiobooks prepare one-minute subtitle sections at the current listening position, cache partial work and reuse the Apple Silicon speech model. Position, chapter and speed are saved locally. Embedded covers form the audio background, and playback continues when the Mac window is closed, with native media controls. Newly selected sections still need local recognition; speech accuracy depends on the recording. iCloud sync still requires Apple signing.

title: Quiet advanced-level subtitle highlighting
notes: Use a shared token-aware highlighting policy to skip automatic particle, auxiliary, name and grammatical-fragment highlights caused by homophone level collisions. Keep explicit known/unknown choices authoritative.

Replace solid Mac word blocks with subtle underlines and use furigana only for highlighted vocabulary. Validate a near-N1 profile against the reported sentence in Chromium and WebKit; personal N2-completed/known-word choices stay on the user's device.

title: Add local video, Japanese audiobooks and offline Mac study
notes: Add native file opening and a persistent library for MP4/MOV video, M4B/M4A audiobooks and other supported audio, including chapters, seeking, offline subtitles and saved context. Add accessible YouTube downloads and filtered in-app search.

Share iOS preference, familiarity and coverage rules; add furigana, pitch, saved words, settings backups, context suggestions, version history, hover pause/resume and Mac shortcuts. Add default WebKit ad-request filtering and original-Japanese metadata checks.

Improve MLX speech with bounded chunks, one worker, silence/confidence handling, separate fast/accuracy caches and model comparison/replay. Validate native M4B import and both WebKit/Chromium playback flows; benchmark a 35-second natural-speech excerpt on M1 Pro.

Google embedded account login remains unavailable. Automatic cross-device iCloud sync is deferred until signing is configured; JSON backups can be saved to iCloud Drive. Complete ad removal, every restricted video, and perfect transcription cannot be guaranteed.

title: Open immersed in a native Apple Silicon window
notes: Compile an arm64 AppKit application with persistent embedded WebKit playback, native menus and no browser launch. Fix JLPT word highlighting using shared iOS vocabulary data and morphology; add hover lookup, pause and Space/arrow shortcuts.

The Mac interface is not yet at iOS feature parity. iCloud signing is deferred; YouTube login, ad filtering, language filtering and offline playback remain unfinished. Generated transcripts require audio verification, and restricted videos can remain unavailable.

title: Add a searchable Mac app launcher
notes: Create Immersed Mac.app in ~/Applications on first launch so the Homebrew install is visible in Finder, Spotlight, and Launchpad. The app launcher reuses the local service when it is already running.
Keep the app as an unsigned launcher for the browser-based Mac prototype; this does not add a signed native app or DMG.

title: Show Mac subtitle chunks and iPhone–Mac artwork
notes: Add original concept artwork to the repository and describe Immersed as an iPhone and Mac project. The Mac companion now publishes each 60-second Japanese recognition chunk and waits for the first subtitle before playback.

The Mac worker still needs a real macOS installation and accuracy test; its initial audio download/model startup can be slow and some YouTube videos may block playback or audio access. iPhone captionless generation remains unavailable in Expo Go.

title: Add local Mac transcription draft
notes: Add a macOS study window in the same repository with YouTube playback, generated Japanese subtitles, clickable dictionary lookup, known words and sentence navigation. Local MLX Whisper large-v3-turbo on Apple Silicon and faster-whisper large-v3 on Intel transcribe downloaded audio.

Add a Homebrew tap formula and launch command. First launch downloads dependencies, dictionary and model; Mac hardware, YouTube audio access, speed and accuracy are not yet validated. This is a browser-window prototype, not a signed native app, and subtitles appear after full transcription rather than in real time.

title: Load mobile YouTube Japanese caption URLs
notes: Resolve path-relative mobile YouTube timedtext URLs against the selected watch page before validating and fetching them. This addresses the iPhone track rejection observed on eslI8_s5blg and stops repeated diagnostic spam.

Automatic speech captions for videos with no usable Japanese track still require verified audio capture. The cloud preview cannot fetch YouTube audio; the native iPhone prototype requires an Apple-signed build and device test.

title: Restore early Japanese caption capture
notes: Capture Japanese caption responses that arrive before the watch-page bridge starts, preserving tappable subtitles when YouTube exposes a track. Add track-source diagnostics for the iPhone.

Captionless videos still require audio speech recognition. This Expo preview cannot obtain YouTube audio on its cloud network; on-device recognition requires a signed iPhone build and device validation.

title: Restore large portrait player and retry Japanese caption formats
notes: Restore the earlier tall video area and default zoomed portrait playback; pinch inward fits the complete frame and outward fills the viewing area.
Try both JSON3 and the original Japanese track format when YouTube returns an empty caption response, and log track languages and fetch outcomes for iPhone diagnosis.

Videos without an accessible Japanese track still need speech recognition. This preview cloud receives proxy 403 for YouTube audio; the on-device prototype requires an Apple-signed build and is not available in Expo Go.

title: Recover verified Japanese caption text without DOM language tags
notes: When YouTube confirms its selected track is Japanese, use rendered caption fragments even if YouTube omits lang attributes; retain guards against English or translated track fallback.

Add source diagnostics to distinguish missing YouTube caption tracks from a blocked transcription worker on real iPhones. The earlier audio-transcription pipeline was not removed; this preview server still receives proxy 403 when it requests YouTube audio.
Captionless videos in Expo Go still need a reachable audio source; the native local-caption prototype requires a signed iPhone build.

title: Prototype on-device Japanese captions from iPhone app audio
notes: Add a native iOS proof of concept that requests ReplayKit and Speech permission, captures app-audio samples transiently, and sends them to Apple's on-device Japanese recognizer for tappable timed lines when source captions are absent.

This feature requires a custom signed iPhone build and cannot run in Expo Go. An unsigned simulator build compiled successfully; live YouTube audio capture, accuracy, timing and protected-content behavior still require iPhone testing.
YouTube access and policy review remain necessary before an App Store release; the cloud transcription worker still cannot access YouTube audio on this preview network.

title: Restore hosted-player captions and compact video layout
notes: Relay Japanese caption, clock and playback messages from the HTTPS YouTube iframe to the iPhone app; relay sentence controls back to the frame and place the reading panel directly below the video.

The captionless-video transcription worker remains blocked from YouTube audio on this preview network. A source video with no accessible Japanese track cannot be generated here; the app now reports this without calling it a YouTube subtitle requirement.
Live iPhone verification of the new relay remains necessary; no claim is made that every YouTube video can be transcribed or embedded.

title: Try HTTPS YouTube player when iPhone watch playback fails
notes: When YouTube marks a public watch video unplayable in the iPhone WebView, try its official iframe player from the Expo preview's HTTPS origin, with a referrer and Japanese caption preferences.

Playback and clickable subtitles in the fallback still require verification on an iPhone. YouTube can restrict embedding, and videos without Japanese tracks still need a supported transcription source; this preview cannot guarantee every video.
The HTTPS fallback currently uses the live Expo preview origin and requires permanent hosting before production release.

title: Keep YouTube player in focus
notes: Hide watch-page title, actions and comments by following the visible player through YouTube's changing mobile layout.
Retry the caption and playback-diagnostic bridge after the watch page finishes loading so About can report an actual player state.
Log the same playback state to the active Expo preview for device-side diagnosis.
The iPhone's Video unavailable error is not yet diagnosed from a device report; signing credentials are also still required for a TestFlight build.

title: Focus YouTube watch pages and diagnose playback
notes: Hide watch-page metadata and comments without repositioning YouTube's player, and defer caption hooks until the page loads.
Let YouTube enter native fullscreen when inline playback is unavailable.
Show YouTube playability and media diagnostics under Settings → About when a video fails.
The public Kiyo video still needs an on-device playback check; this cloud cannot access YouTube media, and videos without source captions still need accessible audio for transcription.

title: Use YouTube watch pages for playback
notes: Open videos directly on YouTube's normal mobile watch page so creator-disabled embeds do not bounce learners back to discovery.
Keep the site's player layout intact, while retaining Japanese subtitle capture and study controls.
YouTube can still restrict private, region-limited or account-required videos; captionless transcription remains limited by source-audio access.

title: Restore playback for videos that block embedding
notes: When YouTube rejects the embedded player, automatically retry the same video on its normal watch page inside Immersed while keeping the learning view.
If YouTube also blocks the normal watch page, return to discovery with a clear message; source-audio restrictions still limit captionless transcription.

title: Recover from blocked YouTube embeds
notes: Return to YouTube discovery when a video owner blocks embedded playback, instead of leaving a dead player and empty subtitle area.
Owner-restricted videos still cannot play inside Immersed, and captionless YouTube transcription remains blocked by source-audio access.

title: Prepare iOS App Store project
notes: Link Immersed to the owner's Expo project and add in-app privacy and support links with draft App Store listing and review steps.
Apple Developer membership is confirmed, but signed iPhone testing, App Store Connect setup, persistent language hosting, and captionless-video acceptance remain outstanding.

title: Acoustic timing and persistent-host deployment
notes: Added a standalone HTTPS host and production native bundles, with Docker deployment instructions. A permanent host has not yet been connected or deployed.
Added optional audio-conditioned word alignment, explicit estimated-timing fallback, and reusable recognizer processes across chunks.

Larger recognizers tied or lost to the baseline in local read-speech tests; no recognition accuracy gain is claimed. Current cloud YouTube audio access remains blocked and preview URLs remain temporary.

title: Recover the preview and repair subtitle timing and cache priority
notes: Supervise the Expo preview with bounded automatic restarts. Expo addresses can change; the workspace still needs to stay running.
Respect source word timestamps and clears, retain sentence skipping across rolling updates, reject invalid timelines, and continue fresh live captions beyond exhausted coverage.

Preserve cached caption provenance and verified silence coverage; retry temporary word-analysis failures automatically. Source audio access is still blocked and ASR/slang accuracy and generated alignment remain imperfect.

title: Add corpus cross-checks and steady player navigation
notes: Rank dictionary homophones with general word-pair/triple counts, pronunciation and grammar guards; sparse cases require agreement with a local model. ASR contextual overrides also need sequence evidence. No paid model API is required.
Keep the discovery icon and video boundary consistent across study, dictionary and settings. Improve GitHub discovery, previews and contribution guidance.
Frequency is not proof: source captions stay unchanged, rare words can lack corpus evidence, and this preview still cannot acquire audio for captionless YouTube videos.

title: Improve grammar lookups and caption homophone suggestions
notes: Group conjectural grammar such as だろうなって; distinguish auxiliary う from dictionary animal nouns with POS-specific caches.
Add context-ranked same-reading spelling suggestions for supplied captions, including 自称/事象 and 累計/類型. Explicit selection preserves the original caption spelling.

Stabilize the video split and word popup height, collapse extra dictionary entries and request minimal YouTube controls. Source captions can still be wrong; no OCR or verified audio correction is added.

title: Keep subtitle words visible and improve reading timing
notes: Preserve overlapping captions, exact-boundary appends, unparsed words and source sentences crossing partial ASR coverage.
Add bounded reading grace, retain word end times, merge equal-timestamp cues, and avoid ending captions at arbitrary chunk boundaries.

Reserve three furigana rows, grow the reading area with content, and reset caption scroll on sentence changes. Real iPhone timing/layout still need device testing; source-audio access remains blocked.

title: Use Japanese context to check confusing caption alternatives
notes: Add a pinned Japanese language model to rank existing close-sounding ASR alternatives using surrounding captions; never synthesize replacement words.
Protect proper/unknown words, numbers and negation; require stronger evidence to override a model majority and retain the original if checks fail.
A constructed homophone example improved; six recorded diagnostic clips stayed at 22.3% CER. General speech accuracy gains and real YouTube validation remain unproven.

title: Compare three Japanese speech recognizers progressively
notes: Add ReazonSpeech K2, Kotoba Whisper and Whisper Small with per-chunk text agreement, alternatives and measured timings.
Stream partial caption updates through polling; preserve creator tracks while cross-checking automatic sources; invalidate stale recognition caches.
Model disagreement remains unverified. CPU comparison is incremental, not guaranteed real-time. Kotoba timing is approximate; YouTube source audio remains blocked here.

title: Improve Japanese subtitle recognition
notes: Replace Whisper base with open Japanese ReazonSpeech K2 int8; diagnostic sample CER improved from 48.7% to 29.1%, pending real YouTube validation.
Use timestamped characters to build short Japanese caption cues, with overlapping bounded audio chunks and a model-versioned cache.
Native and creator subtitle tracks may still contain errors; preview network restrictions prevent full YouTube transcription testing and this model does not diarize speakers.

title: Separate word lookup, better expressions and optional pitch accents
notes: Restored subtitle word popup with pause/resume; Dictionary search and Settings keep playing in a larger lower panel.
Dictionary-backed expressions including 気を抜く retain whole meanings across supported inflections. Vocabulary indicator now shows one conservative familiar-word percentage.
Optional recorded Tokyo pitch accents from pinned Kanjium data in word lookups and dictionary search; absent patterns are hidden.
Fresh captionless YouTube transcription, embedded Google sign-in and locked-screen playback remain unsupported in this preview; native playback and keyboard behavior still need iPhone testing.

title: Keep watching with inline panels and vocabulary estimates
notes: Keep the selected video visible and playing above Dictionary, word lookup and Settings. These panels replace the lower reading area, and remain full screen without a selected video.
Remove automatic pause/resume on navigation or word taps. Keep explicit play/pause controls available and preserve a deliberate pause.
Add caption-sample vocabulary coverage estimates using JLPT level and personal knowledge; show a range for unrated words and avoid claiming measured comprehension.
Adapt dictionary search to the lower panel and add iOS keyboard avoidance so the video can remain visible while typing.

Native continuous playback and keyboard behavior need physical-iPhone validation. Estimates require enough Japanese captions; fresh captionless YouTube transcription and in-app YouTube account sign-in remain unsupported.

title: Compact captions, simpler lookup and joined word fragments
notes: Bring wrapped subtitle rows closer while retaining the base text size. Add central play/pause between previous and next controls in study and lookup.
Simplify the dictionary sheet: scrollable meanings, one Save action and a reachable known/unknown switch at bottom right. Keep tap-to-dismiss and playback intent.
Fix compound-prefix lookup forms such as お名前 and 再利用, including suru inflections.

Automatically join short adjacent cues when Japanese morphology and a dictionary confirm a word or inflection across the boundary; preserve source glyphs and outer timestamps, process progressively and validate every result.

Boundary joining is conservative and cannot repair all ASR mistakes or DOM-only caption splits. Real iPhone layout and audio accuracy remain unverified; fresh captionless YouTube transcription and in-app account sign-in remain unsupported here.

title: Pinch to fit, quicker skipping and quieter subtitles
notes: Default to the full video frame with black bars. Pinch outward to fill and inward to restore fit without reloading or hiding subtitles.
Make sentence controls larger, rounder and more spaced. Activate on touch-down, deduplicate release, and prevent stale clocks from briefly restoring the old caption during seeks.
Add persistent Any, 15+, 30+ and 60+ minute preferences; filter recognizable loaded YouTube cards by visible duration, hiding live or unreadable-duration cards when enabled.
Use neutral subtitle text with a soft highlight only for unfamiliar words, retaining word/grammar lookup and JLPT/personal knowledge overrides.

Pinch behavior and buffering speed need physical-iPhone verification; duration filtering depends on YouTube markup. In-app account sign-in and fresh captionless YouTube transcription remain unsupported in this preview.

title: Quicker lookup, sentence controls and Japanese names
notes: Tap dictionary text, empty space or the backdrop to dismiss immediately and restore the prior playback intent; action buttons retain their functions.
Add previous/next caption controls in the reading area and lookup, absolute seeking, and a dedicated left-edge back gesture with panel history.
Prefetch nearby word analysis, stabilize the furigana lane, render at cue boundaries and forward native cue changes promptly. Use player APIs without synthetic CC taps.
Add 743,685 JMnedict name entries beside JMdict, with proper-name priority, reading alternatives, name categories and Japanese/romanized-name search.

Remove the ineffective Safari sign-in redirect. In-app YouTube account sign-in remains unsupported; provider toolbar behavior and edge gestures need physical-iPhone testing. Fresh YouTube transcription remains blocked by audio access.

title: Natural Japanese subtitles and a clearer project showcase
notes: Remove the permanent subtitle label, separate About from settings, tighten Japanese text spacing, attach punctuation and place furigana above the base text.
Prefer creator Japanese captions over automatic tracks, preserve rolling-caption timing, and invalidate old parsed caption caches without touching saved words.
Add dock and browse swipes, fix Metro fallback forwarding, and publish a screenshot gallery, project illustration and subtitle-quality findings.
